add-on-in-the-list.alt: A screenshot of a public list of everything for sale, showing a Chair and a Cover, each with its own Book now link
add-on-in-the-list.caption: An add-on marked as sellable on its own is listed like anything else, with its own booking link.
add-on-in-the-list.galleryCaption: A public list where an add-on is offered on its own as well as with the thing it goes with.
add-on-in-the-list.socialBody: Combine an add-on with the thing it goes with, or mark it as something people may buy on its own. Where it stands alone it gets its own page and is not called an add-on.
add-on-in-the-list.socialHeading: Sell an extra on its own too

api-keys-list.alt: A screenshot of the API keys page, listing a key named Shopfront that has never been used, above the form for making another
api-keys-list.caption: The list names each key the owner has handed out, and never shows the key itself.
api-keys-list.galleryCaption: An API key list naming a key without showing the key itself.
api-keys-list.socialBody: Hand a key to a system you run, like a shop till or a back-office tool. The site shows it once, then only its name, and you can take it back at any moment.
api-keys-list.socialHeading: Let another system work for you

attendee-csv-export.alt: A screenshot of the Retreat attendee tab, showing one Guest place on Saturday 15 August 2026 and an Export CSV link
attendee-csv-export.caption: The attendee tab names the booking date and the one place on the Retreat listing, with the CSV export link.
attendee-csv-export.galleryCaption: A Retreat attendee tab with a booking date and an Export CSV link.
attendee-csv-export.socialBody: Open a listing's attendee tab to see bookings and export the list as CSV. For day-based listings, the exported date range uses the days the customer chose.

backup-restore.alt: A screenshot of the restored Summer Concert attendee tab, showing Jane Doe and jane@example.com
backup-restore.caption: Restoring the saved backup brings back the Summer Concert listing with Jane Doe and her email on its attendee tab.
backup-restore.galleryCaption: A restored attendee list showing Jane Doe and her email.
backup-restore.socialBody: Restoring a saved backup brings its listings and bookings back. The restored attendee list shows Jane Doe and her email.

balance-payment-link.alt: A screenshot of the balance payment page for a Retreat booking, showing an £80 full order price, £30 already paid and a £50 balance due
balance-payment-link.caption: The page a customer opens from their payment link, naming what they booked, what they have paid and what is left.
balance-payment-link.galleryCaption: A balance page for a Retreat place with £80 ordered, £30 paid and £50 left.
balance-payment-link.socialBody: Record a deposit when an order is made, then collect and track the remaining balance later.

bundle-booking-page.alt: A screenshot of the booking form for the Weekend package, showing a number of packages choice and the Breakfast and Tent included in each one
bundle-booking-page.caption: A package that hides nothing names each thing inside it on its own booking page.
bundle-booking-page.galleryCaption: A package booking page naming every item the buyer gets.
bundle-booking-page.socialBody: Combine listings into one bundle. Set each member's price and quantity, then let customers choose a package count.

checked-in-on-the-day.alt: A screenshot of a listing's activity record, showing an attendee checked in via scanner, the attendee created, and the listing created
checked-in-on-the-day.caption: A check-in at the door is written into the record a listing keeps of its own day, alongside everything else that happened to it.
checked-in-on-the-day.galleryCaption: A listing's own record, with a door check-in written into it.
checked-in-on-the-day.socialBody: Each listing keeps its own record of what happened to it, including who was checked in at the door and when.
checked-in-on-the-day.socialHeading: Each listing keeps its own record

contact-record.alt: A screenshot of a contact record, showing 9 visits, 5 online bookings, 2 admin bookings, 4 messages sent and a private note reading VIP Sam
contact-record.caption: What the site remembers about someone, and the private note only the organiser reads.
contact-record.galleryCaption: One person's record, showing how often they booked, how often they were in touch, and a private note.
contact-record.socialBody: See how often someone booked, how often they have been in touch, and a private note only the organiser reads.
contact-record.socialHeading: Keep a record of each person

editor-listings-without-takings.alt: A screenshot of an editor's listings table, showing the Pottery listing's status, booked-place count and ticket count with no income, cost or profit columns
editor-listings-without-takings.caption: An editor sees the listing and booked-place count, but no ticket income, costs or profit.
editor-listings-without-takings.galleryCaption: An editor's listing view, with no money columns.
editor-listings-without-takings.socialBody: An editor can work on listings and see their status and booked-place count. The listing view does not show ticket income, costs or profit.
editor-listings-without-takings.socialHeading: Give an editor a money-free listing view

group-booking-arrives.alt: A screenshot of the Summer Concert attendee list, showing Jane Doe, her email, the Medium size she picked and one place
group-booking-arrives.caption: A booking made on a group page arrives with the person, how to reach them, what they picked and the one place they took.
group-booking-arrives.galleryCaption: An attendee list holding a booking made from a group page, with the answer the customer picked.
group-booking-arrives.socialBody: Put several listings on one page and let a customer book them together. Each booking reaches the organiser with the answers it was given.
group-booking-arrives.socialHeading: Sell several listings on one page

listing-ledger.alt: A screenshot of the income statement for a Workshop listing, showing a £50 balance and one line, a booking worth £50
listing-ledger.caption: One paid booking, written down once, on the statement for the listing it was paid to.
listing-ledger.galleryCaption: A listing's statement with one paid booking and the £50 balance it leaves.
listing-ledger.socialBody: Track booking income, offline payments, refunds, costs and outstanding balances in the same ledger.

maintenance-cost-on-a-room.alt: A screenshot of a service event's costs, showing £90 for a boiler part recorded against Room A
maintenance-cost-on-a-room.caption: What the work cost, recorded against the room the hold took out of use.
maintenance-cost-on-a-room.galleryCaption: A maintenance cost recorded against the room it was spent on.
maintenance-cost-on-a-room.socialBody: A hold takes dates out of use for maintenance without adding a customer to the list. What the work cost goes against the room it was spent on, so the repair reaches that room's money record.

one-days-audience.alt: A screenshot of the bulk email page addressed to attendees of the Course on Tuesday 11 August 2026, saying it reaches 1 recipient
one-days-audience.caption: The compose page names the listing and the one day the message is aimed at, and counts who that day reaches.
one-days-audience.galleryCaption: A bulk email addressed to one day of a course rather than to the whole term.
one-days-audience.socialBody: A course booked date by date can be written to one date at a time. Choose the date on the attendee list, and the message reaches that date's people rather than everyone booked on the term.
one-days-audience.socialHeading: Email one date of a course

page-anybody-can-read.alt: A screenshot of a public site page called Directions, reached from the site's own navigation alongside Home and Listings
page-anybody-can-read.caption: A page is live at the address its owner chose as soon as it is written, for a visitor who never signs in.
page-anybody-can-read.galleryCaption: A page the organiser wrote, live at the address they chose.
page-anybody-can-read.socialBody: Write a page, choose the web address it lives at, and it is there for anyone to read straight away.

paid-more-than-asked.alt: A screenshot of a Donate listing's income statement, showing an £80 balance from one booking of £80
paid-more-than-asked.caption: When a listing lets people pay more than it asks, it earns what they chose to pay.
paid-more-than-asked.galleryCaption: A donation listing earning the £80 a supporter chose to pay.
paid-more-than-asked.socialBody: Set a minimum and let supporters pay more. What the listing earns is what they chose, wherever the figure is shown.
paid-more-than-asked.socialHeading: Let people pay what they want

payment-provider-choice.alt: A screenshot of the payment provider settings, showing Stripe chosen from None, Square, Stripe and SumUp, and a saved Stripe test key
payment-provider-choice.caption: Choose one active provider and keep saved credentials available when switching.
payment-provider-choice.galleryCaption: Payment provider settings with Stripe selected and its saved test key.
payment-provider-choice.socialBody: Select Stripe, Square or SumUp. Saved credentials remain available when the organiser switches provider.

place-lost-while-paying.alt: A screenshot of the note the site writes against a booking, saying it was kept at quantity 0 and its payment refunded because the event filled up while they were paying
place-lost-while-paying.caption: Somebody whose payment arrived after the last place had gone is kept, refunded once, and the reason is written against their booking.
place-lost-while-paying.galleryCaption: The note left when a payment arrives after the last place has gone.
place-lost-while-paying.socialBody: Capacity is used when payment is confirmed, not when checkout starts. Whoever confirms second is refunded once, and the organiser is told why.
place-lost-while-paying.socialHeading: A payment that loses the place is refunded

qr-code-check-in.alt: A screenshot of the manual check-in search on a listing's scanner page, showing Alice and her one place ready to check in
qr-code-check-in.caption: Look someone up by name when their ticket cannot be scanned.
qr-code-check-in.galleryCaption: Manual check-in for someone whose ticket cannot be scanned.
qr-code-check-in.socialBody: Scan a booking QR code with a phone camera, or pick the person from the list of those still to arrive when a camera cannot be used.

record-put-right.alt: A screenshot of a contact record with the counts corrected to 9 visits, 11 online bookings, 2 admin bookings and 7 messages, and a private note reading Paid in cash
record-put-right.caption: The counts and the private note are for the organiser to correct, and what they save is what the record then says.
record-put-right.galleryCaption: A contact record whose counts and private note the organiser has corrected.
record-put-right.socialBody: The counts a record holds and the note kept against it are yours to correct, and nobody but the organiser reads the note.

record-repaired.alt: A screenshot of a contact record that opened after its note could not be read, still showing 9 visits and 5 online bookings, with a note reading Repaired
record-repaired.caption: When the private note cannot be read, the record still opens and still shows the counts, and saving over it gives a working record back.
record-repaired.galleryCaption: A record that opened and kept its counts after its encrypted note could not be read.
record-repaired.socialBody: If an encrypted note cannot be read, the record still opens and still shows what was counted, and saving over it gives a working record back.

refunded-booking.alt: A screenshot of one booking's money after a refund, showing a £45 sale, its payment, the income removed and the £45 handed back
refunded-booking.caption: A refund undoes the sale and hands the money back, so the listing has earned nothing and the customer owes nothing.
refunded-booking.galleryCaption: One booking's money after a refund, adding up to nothing owed.
refunded-booking.socialBody: Refunding hands back the ticket price, any booking fee and any service charge, and the listing stops counting the sale.

servicing-studio-floor-hold.alt: A screenshot of the service event form for a studio floor treatment, showing a two-day hold on four Ceramics Studio Sessions places
servicing-studio-floor-hold.caption: Reserve capacity for maintenance across one day or several days.
servicing-studio-floor-hold.galleryCaption: Service events hold places without adding a customer to the list.
servicing-studio-floor-hold.socialBody: Block places for maintenance, setup or staff use without adding a customer to the attendee list.

site-pages-in-order.alt: A screenshot of the owner's list of site pages, showing Parking, Directions and Opening in that order with the address each one lives at
site-pages-in-order.caption: Pages are offered in the order the owner puts them, and each one keeps the address it was given.
site-pages-in-order.galleryCaption: An organiser's own pages, in the order they chose.
site-pages-in-order.socialBody: Write your own pages, choose the address each one lives at, and put them in the order you want them offered in.

stay-length-on-the-page.alt: A screenshot of a Lodge listing's page, showing it is booked daily, on any day of the week, with a booking duration of 3 days
stay-length-on-the-page.caption: A listing booked by the day says how long each booking lasts on its own page, without opening the edit form.
stay-length-on-the-page.galleryCaption: A listing booked by the day, saying each booking lasts three days.
stay-length-on-the-page.socialBody: Set how many days one booking covers. The length is on the listing's own page, and the days a booking covers use capacity when its payment is confirmed.

team-and-roles.alt: A screenshot of the users table, showing jo as the owner and sam as an editor, both active
team-and-roles.caption: Somebody invited as an editor sets their own password, and from then on has their own login and one role.
team-and-roles.galleryCaption: A users table with the owner and an editor who joined from an invite.
team-and-roles.socialBody: Invite each person with a link they set their own password on. Their role decides which pages they can open.

volunteer-shift-form.alt: A screenshot of the volunteer sign-up form for the Oakfield Primary Summer Fair, showing set-up, gate and clear-up shifts with eight places each and an access needs question
volunteer-shift-form.caption: Three shifts on one page, each with its own eight places, and a question the organiser added.
volunteer-shift-form.galleryCaption: A volunteer sign-up page with three shifts of eight places and an access-needs question.
volunteer-shift-form.socialBody: Give each shift its own place limit, collect access needs and accept a booking with a £0 total.
